CONVENTION PLANS COMPLETED
Brother Rod TiUman, Rho '56, reports that
plans for the 122nd Anniversary Convention
of Psi Upsilon are near completion and that
all is in readiness for the descent of Psi U's
upon the Four Lakes City of Madison, Wis
consin.

September promises to be its usual en
chanting self on the Wisconsin campus, and
Brothers should come prepared to enjoy the
"Vacation Convention" on the shores of Lake
Rho House of IG97 Mendota. An early morning dip from the
Psi U pier is part of the ritual, as is the
sight of the "glorious orb of day" setting beyond Picnic Point.
From the first breakfast at the Chapter House on Wednesday morning to the last pretzel
at Picnic Point on Saturday, the 1955 Convention promises to be one that all of those

present will forever treasure in their memories.
The Rho asks that Brothers one and all accept our invitation and plan to be with us to
renew fraternal spirit once more.
The Convention Committee

Dear Brother,

When the March issue of The Diamond arrived about a week ago, the Zeta Zeta chapter
received a great shock. On page 113 under the subsection, "Other Deaths Reported" the name of
William L. McCamey, Zeta Zeta '54 was listed. This came as a hard and mysterious blow to us,
as Brother
McCamey was Vice-President this year and had been talking to some Brothers as late
as
May 18.
After investigating Brother McCamey 's circumstances, we found that he is alive and very well.
Undoubtedly it was some error, which I thought you should be informed about. Errors of this
nature can happen, as exemplified by the letter to the editor in this current issue regarding
Brother Crosby in Toronto.
We are very happy that the situation has not proved true, and I am sure that you will be glad
to correct this mis-statement.

Yours in the Bonds,
Allen Baxter, Zeta Zeta '56

We are always happy to receive corrections of this nature, and are glad indeed to pass on to
readers of The Diamond the good news in regard to Brother McCamey.
